description_en: Retrieves stories from a specified drive that match the specified conditions
description_zh: 根据用户指定的条件，查询指定 drive 空间下的故事列表
kebab_example: aliyun pds search-stories --drive-id 1 --story-id 9132e0d8-fe92-4e56-86c3-f5f112308003 --story-type PeopleMemory --story-name Food --story-start-time-range start=2016-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 end=2022-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 --story-end-time-range start=2016-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 end=2022-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 --create-time-range start=2016-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 end=2022-12-31T00:00:00+08:00 --face-group-ids Cluster-be377f73-3502-433c-8309-a01e659c128c --custom-labels 'key1=value1,key2!=value2' --with-empty-stories false --marker NWQ1Yjk4YmI1ZDODBhNDQ2Nzhl000 --limit 100 --sort CreateTime --order desc --cover-image-thumbnail-process image/resize,m_fill,h_128,w_128,limit_0/format,jpg --cover-video-thumbnail-process video/snapshot,t_1000,f_jpg,w_0,h_0,m_fast,ar_auto --url-expire-sec 900 --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchStories

parameters.help_en: The type of the story. You can specify this parameter when you create a story
parameters.help_zh: 故事类型。由用户创建时指定
parameters.name: story_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the story. The name can be up to 1,024 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh:
故事名称。
长度不超过 1024 字节
parameters.name: story_name

fields.help_en: The start time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 起始时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: start

fields.help_en: The end time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The time range of the start time of the photos or videos in a story
parameters.help_zh: 创建故事照片或视频的开始时间范围
parameters.name: story_start_time_range

fields.help_en: The start time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 起始时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: start

fields.help_en: The end time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The time range of the end time of the photos or videos in a story
parameters.help_zh: 创建故事照片或视频的结束时间范围
parameters.name: story_end_time_range

fields.help_en: The start time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 起始时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: start

fields.help_en: The end time in RFC 3339 format
fields.help_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 RFC3339
fields.name: end

parameters.help_en: The time range when the story was created
parameters.name: create_time_range

parameters.help_en: The list of face groups. This parameter is used to query people stories
parameters.help_zh:
人脸分组列表。
查询人物故事时使用
parameters.name: face_group_ids

parameters.help_en: Custom labels. You can query multiple fields separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义标签。
可查询多个字段，使用 "," 分隔
parameters.name: custom_labels

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return empty stories. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回空故事。默认 false
parameters.name: with_empty_stories

parameters.help_en: The pagination marker. If this parameter is empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 查询的起始位置。若为空则表示从头开始查询
parameters.name: marker

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of resources to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100. The number of returned resources can be less than the specified number, but cannot be greater than the specified number
parameters.help_zh:
限定此次返回资源的数量，取值范围[1,100]。
默认 100。
返回结果可以小于指定的数量，但不能多于指定的数量
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The parameters for processing the thumbnail of the cover image
parameters.help_zh: 图片封面缩略图控制参数
parameters.name: cover_image_thumbnail_process

parameters.help_en: The parameters for processing the thumbnail of the cover video
parameters.help_zh: 视频封面缩略图控制参数
parameters.name: cover_video_thumbnail_process

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the thumbnail URL. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 10 to 86400
parameters.help_zh: 缩略图过期时间。单位为秒，最短 10 秒，最长 86400 秒
parameters.name: url_expire_sec
